steps.en: Install and mount the overlay in dev
steps.zh: dev 环境装好并挂上批注层

steps.en: Mount it with a dev guard
steps.zh: 带 dev 开关地挂载

steps.en: Add the stamper to your bundler config
steps.zh: 给打包器配置加打戳插件

steps.en: Stamps every element with its file:line at dev build
steps.zh: dev 构建时给每个元素盖上 file:line 戳

steps.en: Press alt+a, click the element, write what should change
steps.zh: 按 alt+a，点中元素，写下要改什么

steps.en: Resolves selector, source line, CSS rules, box and styles into markdown
steps.zh: 把选择器、源码行、CSS 规则、盒子与样式解析成 markdown

steps.en: Paste it, or let the agent watch over MCP and reply on the pin
steps.zh: 贴给 agent，或让 agent 经 MCP 挂看守、在图钉上回复

steps.en: Tracks the loop in pin colors: blue acknowledged, green resolved
steps.zh: 用图钉颜色跟踪闭环：蓝是 acknowledged，绿是 resolved

value.en: Your agent gets the exact file:line and stylesheet rule — no grep guessing about which component you pointed at.
value.zh: agent 直接拿到准确的 file:line 和样式表规则——不用 grep 猜你指的是哪个组件。
